patent.title: RNA containing modified nucleosides and methods of use thereof
assignees: The Trustees of the University of Pennsylvania
patent.family_note: National phase of PCT/US2006/032372 claiming priority to U.S. provisional 60/710,164 (2005-08-23). Package B early ledger uses grant-date T0 only; later family members and COVID-era products are excluded from this historical state.

knowledge_origin.description: Public patent record identifies university inventorship (Karikó/Weissman), Penn ownership, and NIH-supported research with reserved U.S. Government rights.

technology.problem: Unmodified in vitro-transcribed RNA activates innate immune receptors and is poorly suited as a durable therapeutic expression vector.
technology.mechanism: Incorporate pseudouridine or other modified nucleosides into RNA/mRNA to reduce innate immune activation and improve translation/stability for therapeutic protein expression.
technology.comparison_baseline: Unmodified in vitro-transcribed RNA that activates human TLR3/7/8 and induces stronger dendritic-cell / interferon responses in the cited pre-T0 papers.

value_carriers.name: Therapeutic / vaccine modified-mRNA modality (aspirational at T0; no marketed carrier confirmed)
value_carriers.description: Pre-T0 papers and the patent claim therapeutic gene-replacement and vaccination uses, but at T0=2012-10-02 no public exact-patent mapping to a marketed product is used in this ledger.

gaps.description: At T0=2012-10-02 there is no confirmed exact-patent → marketed product / vaccine carrier link in this ledger. Aspirational therapeutic uses are claimed/described but not implemented as a public commercial carrier here.
needed_evidence: license schedule tying this grant to a marketed product

gaps.description: No public T0 evidence attributes royalty, incremental clinical value, or revenue to this exact patent.
V0.7 can record R0 plus scientific differentiation, but has no structured field for early option/future-value horizon that is decision-relevant precisely when realization is still R0/R1.
needed_evidence: explicit separation of option signals from realized R-stage

notes: Package B early-stage option retrospective #1. T0=grant date 2012-10-02 stops at R0: university NIH-supported patent + peer-reviewed mechanism/option signals exist, but no marketed exact-patent carrier is recorded. COVID-19 vaccine success, later licenses, and royalty outcomes are post-T0 and must not be backfilled into this ledger.
